levels.title: JAVASCRIPT 1 · Clean Syntax & Formatting Basics
levels.concept_capsule: ES2024 and JSDoc require 2-space indentation, explicit semicolons, safe numeric coercion via Number(), and @param/@returns tags to prevent accidental string concatenation.

remedial_drills.prompt: Apply the official formatting and documentation standard.
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Add a JSDoc block `/** ... */` above the function.

keywords_glossary.role: Documents input and return types in JSDoc. In production it powers IDE autocomplete and type checking without a build step.
Exposes a named ESM function, enabling tree-shaking and isolated unit tests.
Explicitly converts operands to numbers before addition so "2" + 3 never turns into "23".

formatting_mechanics.indentation: 2 spaces per block inside the function body (no tabs).
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Multi-line JSDoc block above the signature and body on its own line.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Space after parameter commas (a, b), spaces around +, and trailing semicolon (;).

analogous_example.title: Line-total calculation with JSDoc and numeric coercion
analogous_example.why_it_works: Documents the contract with @param/@returns, uses 2-space indentation, and coerces inputs via Number().

levels.title: JAVASCRIPT 2 · Edge Cases & Documentation
levels.concept_capsule: Combine optional chaining (?.) and nullish coalescing (??) with JSDoc to read nested properties without throwing TypeError on null or undefined inputs.

remedial_drills.title: Syntax Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Fix the syntax error so the snippet parses cleanly.
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Use `?.` on every nullable property in the chain.

remedial_drills.title: Edge-Case Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Add the defensive guard to prevent runtime failures.
remedial_drills.solution_hint: Use `??` instead of `||` so `0` is preserved.

remedial_drills.title: Style & Doc Drill
remedial_drills.prompt: Apply the official formatting and documentation standard.

keywords_glossary.role: Short-circuits property access when an intermediate reference is null or undefined, returning undefined instead of throwing.
Returns the fallback only when the left side is null or undefined (preserving empty strings or 0).
Expresses optional and nullable object contracts in JSDoc for callers.
keywords_glossary.example_inline: @param {{ address?: { city?: string } } | null | undefined} user

formatting_mechanics.indentation: 2 spaces inside the exported function body.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: JSDoc block above export function and single clear return statement.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Spaces around ?? and trailing semicolon on the return statement.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: JSDoc /** ... */ documenting optional properties (?) and null | undefined unions.

analogous_example.title: Safe customer country lookup with ?. and ??
analogous_example.why_it_works: Traverses optional nested objects via ?. and provides a deterministic fallback with ??.
